requirements.statement: Timeline record, mutation, query, and workbook behavior postconditions remain exact across every retained executable selector and declared fixture/runtime boundary.

Every Timeline query, mutation, peer effect, rebuild, reporting, rollback, restore, and portability path derives projection inputs and public rows from one canonical source snapshot and one deterministic derivation policy.

Timeline derives one complete typed projection input, including scalar fields and ordered mention, evidence-reference, and tag collections, from one source snapshot plus typed caller-transaction peer facts; no query, mutation, rebuild, reporting, rollback, restore, or portability path independently reconstructs the public row.

Timeline preserves unmapped source-cell provenance as bounded typed record-lifetime source state with deterministic identity, exact replay, divergent-replay rejection, and no projection, reporting, or collaboration inclusion unless separately authorized.

Timeline applies admitted owner_batch_apply_v1 commands atomically in caller transaction order, validates every stable target before version evaluation, preserves exact replay, and uses a distinct handler for each operation discriminator.
Every first committed Timeline mutation appends one deterministic record_change_intent_v1 for each affected record in the authoritative transaction, while exact idempotent replay appends none.
Timeline owns rough-capture source state, time-profile semantics, lifecycle transitions, and the deterministic interpretation of Timeline records while preserving source text and provenance.

Timeline coordinates peer-owner effects only through typed caller-transaction ports; participants neither commit nor publish independently and Timeline directly accesses only Timeline-owned source tables.
